notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 1043 K, Curie temperature of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 
1185 K, α - γ transition point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.215$ kcal/mol. 
1667 K, γ - δ transition point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.200$ kcal/mol. 
1811 K, melting point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 3.300$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2500 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 9.895 - 0.376 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.450 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=9.895\times10^{-3}T-0.188\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.450\times10^{2}T^{-1}-3.084$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-1043 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = 71.255 + 5.945 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 6.419 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 239.350 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = 71.255 - 5.945 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 6.419 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 119.675 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 10.320 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1043-1185 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 94.816 - 38.036 \times 10^{-3} T + 14.292 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 10.850 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 94.816 + 38.036 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 14.292 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 5.425 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 296.224 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1185-1667 K: $\Delta Hr^{0} = 71.202 + 0.219 \times 10^{-3} T - 1.399 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 129.850 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 71.202 - 0.219 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 1.399 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 64.925 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 24.183 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1667-1811 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -11.692 + 48.716 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 11.030 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 47829.050 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -11.692 - 48.716 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 11.030 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 23914.525 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 360.695 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1811-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 74.157 - 5.276 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.348 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 10.850 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = 74.157 + 5.276 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.348 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 5.425 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 65.103 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
2000-2500 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = 75.182 - 5.860 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.238 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 585.000 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 75.182 + 5.860 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.238 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 292.500 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 69.756 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$
